summary: Helicopters tilt into every change of speed, bank round turns, climb away from the pad and come down a glide path into a low hover.
rationale: The change is movement: one matched before/after WebM of the same scripted transport flight and retarget over the real showroom battlefield (terrain, grass, base, sky; High preset), at normal speed, with the flight path traced so the old vertical climb and descent and the new climb-out and glide path read at a glance. Its poster is the matched moment when the new flight has landed and the old one is still sinking. Silent: the rotor sound change is described in text only.
